notes.title: Patch Notes - November 28 2023
notes.content:
Hello Wandmakers!

New updates have just rolled out from the workshop. The update includes updated visuals, some optimizations, and more fixes. Details are listed below.

Content Update:

 Updated character sprites
 Added a character position tracker in the dungeon by pressing the F3 button, so you can report bugs more accurately to us
 Added damage numbers to Pucelle when hit by enemies
 Added an 'X' sign if you fail a quest


Optimizations:

 Changed the button prompt position when interacting with Watcher (Q/Exit on the left, E/Talk on the right)
 Changed the position of 'Required Material' from left to right in the Crafting screen
 Updated highlighted words in the dialogue box with a larger font
 Reapplied occlusion culling to the 2D environment assets


Fixes:

 Fixed bushes LOD
 Fixed loading screen
 Fixed overlapping quest text
 Fixed wrong button prompts in some UI screens
 Fixed the store collider. No more passing through the wall now
 Fixed the collider of stone rubbles and pink mushroom disks in the dungeon
 Fixed character movement/animation when standing on the edge of a platform
 Fixed the issue that makes the cursor disappear when moving from one tab to another in the menu


The Mushrooms Desperately Need a Break...
We also want to inform you that after a year of developing non-stop, Mushroomallow will take a break this December and will continue development again in January 2024. We will still reply and take note of all bug reports and suggestions we receive, but we'll address them in January.

For Playtesters:
We decided to deactivate the playtest build on December 10 at 11 pm WIB (UTC+7). But once again, if you miss it, you can still play Wonder Wandelier from the demo build, which will be available at all times. Our Discord server is also available at all times if you want to send your feedback.

We hope you enjoy this latest update! Once again, we'd like to thank each one of you for playing Wonder Wandelier and for sending us your feedback and suggestions. It would also mean the world to us if you could share the game or recommend it to a friend who might enjoy it.

Wishing you all a wonderful time this holiday season! Have fun crafting and selling magic wands in Wonder Wandelier!

notes.title: Patch Notes - November 22 2023
notes.content:
Hello Wandmakers!

Hold onto your wands because we've just rolled out a new update. The update includes new visuals for character art and lots of fixes. Detail below!

Content update

 New art for character sprite (will be updated again soon)
 New 1280x720 display resolution

Optimizations

 Removed character sprite (Nyoron and Watcher) when open multiple choice dialogue for better clarity
 Added blur to some UI backgrounds
 Inverted movement direction for mouse scroll function in the menu

Fixes

 Fixed loading screen (need more time)
 Fixed a bug that makes the game freeze by pressing ESC to close Nyoron's dialogue
 Fixed screen border when playing in Steam deck
 Fixed VFX position so now it will show up in front of the trees, not behind them
 Fixed bug where you can still talk to Watcher if you die in front of him

Just a reminder, this playtest will be closed on 25 November 2023 at 11:00 PM WIB (UTC+7). If you missed this playtest event, you can download our game Demo which will be available at all times.

We hope you enjoy this latest update! Once again we'd like to extend our thanks and appreciation for your support for Wonder Wandelier. The feedback and suggestions we've received from you have been crucial in our journey to refine the game.

Lastly, if Wonder Wandelier has left a lasting impression on you, spreading the word by sharing it on your socials or recommending it to a friend who might enjoy it would mean a world to us. 

Have fun crafting and selling magic wands in Wonder Wandelier!
